newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai power agency takes steps to go public.
newsitem.headline: Thai power agency takes steps to go public.

text.p: The state-owned Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) has named a legal adviser to help it go public in the next one to two years.
The utility has named the international law firm, Freshfields, as its legal adviser for the initial phase of privatisation of its thermal power plants, the law firm said on Tuesday.
The power generation capacity of those plants in this privatisation phase was expected to be about 16,500 megawatts, Freshfields said in a statement.
The shares are expected to be floated on the Thai stock market in 1997 or 1998, the statement said.
"This is one of several development initiatives taken by EGAT to encourage a greater role for the private sector in the power industry in Thailand," it said.
